name: [🎃] Parcel Tycoon
desc:
📦 A cozy packing tycoon: sort every item, pack it perfect, and grow from a dumpster to a delivery empire.

A long-lost relative left you their parcel company: a concrete slab and one very good table. The bank wants 30% of everything you ship. Time to get packing!

✅ PACK IT FOR REAL: drag every item in, turn it, tip it, wrap the fragile ones, fill the gaps, tape it shut and stamp it right.
💰 SMALLER BOX, BIGGER PAY: Optimize and get a snug, perfect pack which earns bonus cash.
👥 YOUR FRIENDS ARE YOUR CUSTOMERS, and they can come work for you.
🏗️ BUILD YOUR DEPOT: walls, conveyors with old school tycoon upgraders, trucks, a loading dock, a pallet bay, and a loft that goes from mattress-on-the-floor to marble penthouse.
🐹 HANDLE WITH CARE: sort for glass, heavy loads, even build habitats for LIVE pets in their own carriers.
⭐ RARE CUSTOMERS: luck brings legendary orders with star items.

Up to 6 players per server. Made for phone, tablet and PC.

llm.loop: receive orders -> drag, rotate and pack items snugly into boxes, tape and stamp -> ship for cash -> build depot with conveyors, trucks and upgraders
llm.objectives: grow from a dumpster to a delivery empire
llm.progression: cash, depot buildout, loft upgrades, rare legendary orders, badges
llm.instructions: pack items for real (rotate, wrap fragile, fill gaps, tape, stamp); smaller box earns bonus; friends can be customers or workers; build your depot
unique: hands-on 3D packing puzzle inside a tycoon
friends act as customers or employees
llm.thumbnails: cute packing scenes: Halloween box, PERFECT FIT conveyor, PACK WITH CARE pets in carriers
llm.complexity_notes: item drag/rotate packing with fit scoring, conveyors, depot building, many item models, badges
